name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-shell
description: Standard FrontX application template - target scaffold for template-side code relocation
//: overrides pins several things for unrelated reasons, all load-bearing: "nwsapi": "2.2.28" pins jsdom's transitive CSS-matching engine past a performance regression: on 2.2.26 and 2.2.27, @testing-library/user-event's getComputedStyle-based pointer-events checks hang 25-30 s per click, enough to time out packages/studio's ThemeSelector.test.tsx (measured on 2.2.27 with the current studio sheet and with the earlier one, so the cause is not escaped selectors in STUDIO_CSS); 2.2.28 runs the same tests in milliseconds. jsdom's own range (^2.2.16) still allows 2.2.27, hence the pin. template-mfe/package.json carries the same pin for the same reason. "reselect": "5.2.0" dedupes reselect for the shared-unit build's version check (closure_enforcement.version_check fails when two versions of a shared package are reachable from the shared closure): recharts pins reselect exactly at 5.2.0 while @reduxjs/toolkit (^5.1.0) and @base-ui/utils (^5.2.0) accept it, so one copy at 5.2.0 satisfies every dependent instead of a 5.3.0 root copy plus a 5.2.0 copy nested under recharts. template-mfe/package.json carries the same override for the same reason. "@tanstack/store": "0.11.2" dedupes @tanstack/store for the same version check: @tanstack/react-store 0.11.1 (reached through @gears-frontx/ui-kit's @tanstack/react-table) pins it exactly at 0.11.1 while @tanstack/react-store 0.11.2 (reached through @tanstack/react-router) pins 0.11.2, so without the override the shared closure reaches two versions. template-mfe/package.json carries the same override for the same reason.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build:packages:auth && npm run build:packages:state && npm run build:packages:i18n && npm run build:packages:framework && npm run build:packages:react && npm run build:packages:studio && npm run build:packages:unit-producer && npm run build:packages:vite-plugin-shell
scripts.build: npm run build:mfes && npm run generate:mfe-manifests && vite build && npm run layout:dist
scripts.build:clean: npm run cache:clear && npm run build
scripts.type-check:packages: npm run type-check:packages:auth && npm run type-check:packages:state && npm run type-check:packages:i18n && npm run type-check:packages:framework && npm run type-check:packages:react && npm run type-check:packages:studio && npm run type-check:packages:unit-producer && npm run type-check:packages:vite-plugin-shell
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:package && npm run type-check:package:test && npm run type-check:app && npm run type-check:scripts && npm run type-check:packages && npm run type-check:mfe
